appDescription: Travel Crumbs records the places visited on a car trip and recommends travel routes and courses that other drivers shared.

function.name: RECORD_CURRENT_PLACE
function.description: Records the vehicle's current location as a draft place in the active Travel Crumbs trip.

function.name: CONTROL_CURRENT_TRIP
function.description: Pauses, resumes, or asks to end the trip that Travel Crumbs is currently recording.

operation.description: What to do with the current Travel Crumbs trip recording.

function.name: SHOW_TRAVEL_INFO
function.description: Recommends Travel Crumbs travel routes and courses for a region or near the vehicle and shows them on the screen, or tells today's Travel Crumbs trip records.

infoType.description: RECOMMENDED_ROADMAPS for travel route or course recommendations, TODAY_RECORDS for the places recorded today.

region.description: Korean city, county, district or province the user wants travel route recommendations for; omit when no place is named.
